meta.title: How this site is tested | Pedro Morago
meta.description: Every push to this site is tested in a real browser at six screen widths, with contrast measured in light and dark mode. It deploys only when every check passes.
meta.shareDescription: Every check that runs before pedromorago.com deploys, and why the external link check runs on its own schedule instead.

title: How this site is tested
lede: This is a small static site with its own test suite. Nothing is published unless every check passes, and that includes this page.

facts.label: Built with
facts.text: HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript, generated from JSON files by a Node.js script with no dependencies

facts.label: Runs
facts.text: On every push and pull request

facts.label: Requests to other servers
facts.text: None. No web fonts and no analytics.

blocks.text: They run on every push and pull request, grouped here by when they run.

items: The build stops if a text field in the source is empty, and names the field.
The pages are rebuilt from the source and compared with what's committed, so a hand edit to a generated page or a forgotten rebuild fails the pipeline.
Every generated page and the 404 page pass HTML validation with html-validate.
robots.txt, the sitemap, the 404 page and the redirects from old addresses are in place, and the sitemap lists exactly the pages of the site.
The case-study pages on disk match the ones in the source, so a renamed page can't be left behind.

blocks.text: In a real browser, on every page

items: No sideways scrolling at six screen widths, from 320 to 1920 pixels.
No JavaScript errors and no console errors.
Every link to a section or to another page of this site points to something that exists, and so does every file the page loads.
No ID is used twice on a page.
One h1 per page, and no skipped heading levels.
A title, a description of the right length, the correct canonical URL, the page language and one block of structured data, with no other language versions claimed.
A share preview of the right type, with an image file that exists.
Contrast of at least 4.5:1 (WCAG AA) for each style of text on the page, in light mode and again in dark mode.
Menu links, buttons, breadcrumb links and the next-case link at least 24 pixels tall on phone screens.
Every link that opens a new tab has `rel="noopener"` and tells screen readers that it opens a new tab.
The Skip to content link lands on the main content.
The menu highlights the section you're reading on the home page, and marks Work on the case studies.

blocks.text: When every check passes on the main branch, the site is deployed to GitHub Pages. A version that fails never goes live, so the Audit passed label on the home page holds for every published version.

External links are checked every Monday, and whenever the copy changes, in a separate workflow that never blocks a deploy. A bad minute at GitHub or LinkedIn shouldn't stop a small text fix from going out, but I still want to find a broken link before anyone else does.
